locations.title: Separate data-only reads from full authorization
locations.comment_body: This data-only lookup calls the full mapper, which requires functional actions. A bank user with only data entitlements cannot authenticate. Separate data-role projection from full authorization mapping.

locations.title: Validate data lists at the data-filter boundary
locations.comment_body: Role-only responses now pass this validation, but the data-filter caller dereferences data_entitlements. Preserve endpoint-specific validation before conversion. The previous path also rejected this payload; this finding concerns null handling and error classification.

locations.title: Preserve EMS2 role filtering and aggregation
locations.comment_body: Keeping the first role changes ordinary EMS2 behavior. Main aggregates non-super roles and rejects a super-user-only account. Preserve those semantics for EMS2_ONLY and add both boundary cases.

locations.classification: Policy question; earlier P1 fallback claim withdrawn
locations.title: Clarify unused EMS3 failure configuration
locations.comment_body: The new failClosed setting has no consumer. Tests explicitly require no EMS2 fallback after EMS3 failure. Clarify the property contract and disable-setting scope before changing failure behavior.

locations.title: Disable raw migration logging by default
locations.comment_body: Default migration settings enable these raw cache dumps at INFO. This adds user authorization and data-role details to logs. Disable raw diagnostics by default and use aggregate comparison information.

locations.title: Honor cache disabling and mapping version changes
locations.comment_body: Cache reads ignore enabled and accept envelopes without checking the configured mapping version. The mapper also hardcodes ems3-v1. Honor disabling and reject old mapping versions before returning cached permissions.

locations.title: Resolve removal of the scoped Kong token contract
locations.comment_body: This deletion removes the tested v4 scoped-token contract. Existing clients lose the route, and v3 uses a fixed scope. Restore the contract or provide retirement and consumer migration evidence.

locations.title: Preserve trusted role identity for admin tokens
locations.comment_body: EMS3 entities have no roleName. Admin token construction emits ENTITY:null, and ownership checks then use null as the role. Preserve trusted role identity across mapping and admin validation.

locations.title: Preserve application boundaries during permission merging
locations.comment_body: Merging by entity name discards application identity. If A grants S and B grants only T for entity E, B gains S through the union. Preserve application boundaries through the final tile filter.

locations.title: Preserve settings omitted by legacy tile updates
locations.comment_body: Legacy payloads omit these fields, so the DTO supplies EMS2. This update overwrites the stored EMS3 source and clears application fields. Preserve stored settings when fields are absent.

locations.title: Align advertised fallback with actual failure behavior
locations.comment_body: This catch advertises EMS2 fallback, but EMS2 reads exclude migrated scopes. Failed migrated tiles disappear. Confirm the outage policy, then implement per-scope fallback or describe deliberate fail-closed behavior accurately.

locations.classification: Integration gap; bulk migration intent unconfirmed
locations.title: Connect entitlement fields to CSV import
locations.comment_body: These bulk-import fields are never parsed or persisted. New CSV-created tiles default to EMS2; existing records keep their old settings. Complete the import path or reject unsupported entitlement columns explicitly.

locations.title: Retain authorization settings in tile audit history
locations.comment_body: Only the live table receives authorization source and application fields. Audit records omit them, so historical configuration cannot be reconstructed. Extend the audit schema, entity, and builders.

locations.title: Compare equivalent authorization scopes
locations.comment_body: These permission sets cover different tile scopes. Comparing them produces routing-induced DIFFs, including empty EMS2 versus populated EMS3 after full migration. Compare equivalent scopes or report missing baselines separately.

locations.title: Remove complete authorization payloads from INFO logs
locations.comment_body: This INFO statement logs the complete functional authorization response. New merge and login logs also publish permission sets. Replace payloads with counts and status, and verify default log content.
